scope: Targeted novelty/context check of official abstracts only; not a systematic review or full-paper close reading.

sources.title: Molecular Facts: Desiderata for Decontextualization in LLM Fact Verification
sources.relevance: Atomic facts can lack interpretive context; decontextuality and minimality are already established research considerations. Adding context alone is not a novelty claim.

sources.title: A Closer Look at Claim Decomposition
sources.authors: Miriam Wanner; Seth Ebner; Zhengping Jiang; Mark Dredze; Benjamin Van Durme
sources.relevance: Decomposition choices can alter factuality evaluation; errors should not all be attributed to the source document or the verifier.
